members.name: Mr. Narendra Bikram KC
members.role: Managing Director, Scholar Nepal Pvt Ltd
members.bio: Mr. Narendra Bikram KC is Managing Director of Scholar Nepal Pvt Ltd. He has completed master's degree in Geography in 1998 and obtained wide range of experiences governance and planning since more than 20 years. He has involved to prepare LGs profile, Geo-Spatial Periodic Plan, O&M, Project Bank Guideline and implementation Plan, Tourism Master Plan, Transport Master Plan, Disaster management Plan, LDCRP, LDCRF, GEDSI, GRB, Social Accountability, RIAP, Own Source revenue (OSR) digitalization, Climate Resilient, Value Chain, Local Economic Development, GIS Mapping, and  guidelines. Mr KC has worked in various Donor Partners, INGOs and NGOs to excel his capacity in baseline studies, impact assessments, feasibility studies, performance evaluation studies and comparative studies as coordinator/ training expert and consultant.

members.name: Mr. Yadav Ojha
members.role: Disaster Risk Reduction & Humanitarian Response Expert
members.bio: Mr.Yadav Ojha is results-driven development and emergency response professional with over 15 years of progressive experience in Nepal, including direct leadership of post-earthquake relief and recovery operations, disaster risk reduction and management (DRRM), and multi-district humanitarian program delivery. His track record includes coordinating post-disaster needs assessment and relief distribution across affected districts, establishing Local Emergency Operation Centers (LEOCs) and municipal disaster plans, and supporting IDP relief operations. He is experienced in managing large donor-funded portfolios (GIZ/BMZ, EU, UNDP, USAID) up to several million euros with strong budgeting, procurement documentation, risk management, and donor reporting skills, alongside proven capacity building, MEL, and multi-stakeholder coordination. Mr. Ojha is a qualified, and technically and tactically competent manager with experience in all facets of Technical Education and Vocational Training (TEVT), Food security, sustainable livelihoods, agriculture value chain. He has strong experience of working with government, municipalities, private sector and communities.

members.name: Ms. Ratna Shrestha
members.qualification: MA Sociology & Anthropology (CEU, Hungary); PhD Candidate in Gender Studies, TU
members.bio: Ms Ratna Shrestha has over 17 years of dedicated experience in promoting of gender equality and empowering women and girls in Nepal, she has developed plethora of knowledge and skills for sustaining gender equitable norms within both private and public spheres. My expertise lies in ensuring gender mainstreaming across all aspects of development work. As a practitioner, I have amplified the voice of the marginalized community, focusing intersectionality, in diverse areas including peacebuilding, climate smart agriculture, disaster management, WASH, private sectors, accessing sexual and reproductive health services and the protection of GBV survivors’ right. I have also actively work towards social justice and have successfully applied gender transformative norms approaches, in developing training manuals, to address harmful norms that perpetuate GBV. Additionally, she has dedicated to dismantling harmful gender norms that promote gender inequality to sustaining gender equitable society through inclusive policies and programs across all development sectors. She has completed Master’s degree in Sociology and Anthropology from Central European University, Hungary and currently pursuing my PhD in Gender Studies form TU, Nepal.

members.name: Ms. Lalita Bista
members.qualification: Bachelor's in Business Studies, Tribhuvan University
members.bio: Ms. Lalita Bista, a permanent resident of Sudurpaschim Province, is proposed as the Finance and Logistics Associate. She is an administration, finance, and programme support professional with over eight years of experience in financial management, budgeting, procurement, compliance, logistics, and project coordination. Since 2018, she has worked as an Admin and Finance Associate at Scholar Nepal Pvt. Ltd., supporting development and capacity-building initiatives funded by GIZ, UNDP, ADB, Caritas Nepal, and other partners. Her expertise includes financial reporting, accounting, taxation, payroll, procurement, audit coordination, asset management, and logistics. She holds a Bachelor’s degree in Business Studies from Tribhuvan University.

members.name: Mr. Narayan Kumar BC
members.role: Governance Reforms, PFM and Municipal Finance
members.qualification: MBA, PhD Candidate in Fiscal Federalism
members.bio: Mr Narayan Kumar BC with over 25 years of expertise in governance reforms, public financial management, and municipal finance, with strong skills in stakeholder engagement and training delivery. Mr. BC holds a Master’s Degree in Business Administration (MBA) and is currently pursuing a PhD in fiscal federalism. He has coordinated projects with various development partners (ADB, World Bank, UNCDF, UNDP, IFAD, DANIDA, JICA, IMF, etc.) and the Government of Nepal, which is one of his key strengths. He also serves as a Senior Trainer in Planning and Management, PFM, M&E, and Procurement for all tiers of government across different organizations. Experienced project coordinator with over 20 years of expertise in governance reforms, public financial management, and municipal finance, with strong skills in stakeholder engagement and training delivery. Mr. BC holds a Master’s Degree in Business Administration (MBA) and is currently pursuing a PhD in fiscal federalism. He recently completed an OSR-related assignment as a Revenue Policy Expert with UNDP/GTN. He was a team member in the programme design of the second phase of PLGSP (2024–2029) and also contributed to drafting the PLGSP Implementation Guidelines 2025. He has extensive experience in preparing RIAPs, MTEFs, and Periodic Plans for local governments, as well as drafting policies and guidelines for federal, provincial, and local governments. He has coordinated projects with various development partners (ADB, World Bank, UNCDF, UNDP, IFAD, DANIDA, JICA, IMF, etc.) and the Government of Nepal, which is one of his key strengths. He also serves as a Senior Trainer in Planning and Management, PFM, M&E, and Procurement for all tiers of government across different organizations.

members.name: Mr. Rajib Gautam
members.qualification: Former Secretary, Ministry of Law, Justice and Parliamentary Affairs
members.bio: Mr. Rajib Gautam is a former Secretary of the Ministry of Law, Justice and Parliamentary Affairs (GoN) and holds Master Degree in Law with over 30 years' experience in the legal and policy reform sector. He also served as Secretary responsible for the law and justice portfolio at the OPMCM. He has contributed to drafting numerous laws, including the Constitution of Nepal (2072). Currently, he is engaged in drafting various policies and laws and serves as a resource person at the Staff College, where he teaches government and corporate officials.
